name: codnloc Payment Gateway for Whish Money
author: codnloc

sections.description:
WHISH Money payment gateway for WooCommerce.

How do I start using it?

  • Go to pay.codnloc.com, and create account.
  • sign in into your account.
  • Click on the gear icon ⚙️ in the top left of the account.
  • copy you ‘API Secret’ and go back to your admin panel in wordpress website.
  • woocommerce → Payments → Whish Money payment, click Manage
  • paste the ‘API Secret’ into the Secret field.

External services

This plugin use pay.codnloc.com API to make WHISH payment, its send the order infomation to the payment gateway to do the process, and the payment gateway responce the status of the payment if success or not.
This service is provided by pay.codnloc.com:
Terms and conditions: https://pay.codnloc.com/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://pay.codnloc.com/privacy.html
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes sure, You will only pay the transfer fees.
